coverage_note: Area means computed over ~37% of AOI pixels with valid composite data. Approximately 63% of pixels lack cloud-free observations in this April–June window.

figures.title: Vegetation Index Short-Window Signal
figures.subtitle: NDVI area mean, April–June composite
figures.caption: Fig. 1. — NDVI area mean derived from ECOSTRESS/AppEEARS, Swiss National Park April–June composite 2019–2025. Values represent the mean over ~37% of AOI pixels with valid observations. Lowest mean in 2021 (0.109) is directionally consistent with documented drought conditions. 2025 is a partial season. Raster-derived research output — validate before interpretation.

figures.title: Evapotranspiration Short-Window Signal
figures.subtitle: ET area mean (mm/day), April–June composite
figures.caption: Fig. 2. — ET area mean (mm/day) derived from ECOSTRESS/AppEEARS ECO3ETPTJPL, April–June composite 2019–2025. 2024 value is based on only 2 ECOSTRESS overpasses and is LOW CONFIDENCE. 2025 is partial season. Raster-derived research output.

figures.title: Evaporative Stress Signal
figures.subtitle: ESI area mean (0–1, 1 = no stress), April–June composite
figures.caption: Fig. 3. — ESI area mean derived from ECOSTRESS/AppEEARS ECO4ESIPTJPL, April–June composite 2019–2025. Scale: 0 = maximum stress, 1 = no stress. 2024 value is LOW CONFIDENCE (2 overpasses). All values show moderate-to-low stress range (0.78–0.93). Raster-derived research output.

figures.title: Observation Coverage Matrix
figures.subtitle: ECOSTRESS overpass coverage per season (obs_coverage_p95 %)
figures.caption: Fig. 4. — Per-variable observation coverage matrix (p95 percentile of per-pixel observation coverage %), April–June 2019–2025. Higher values indicate more uniform temporal coverage across the AOI. ET/ESI 2024 coverage of 50% reflects only 2 available overpasses — analytically insufficient for seasonal characterization.
